result.brief: 提出按"时刻"而非帧进行视频 tokenize 的无训练加速方法，依据采样间隔与 tokenizer 类型分配 token 预算，缓解 3D patch 跨场景混合问题。
result.reason: Analyzes vision tokenizers and temporal tokenization of video frames, proposing tokenizer-aware token budget allocation; contributes to video representation/tokenization understanding rather than generation.
